verdict.rationale: Fivetran's core function is to move data into a customer's own warehouse/lake, and docs state data lands in open table formats (fivetran-docs-6), and the REST API and MCP server allow programmatic management and even copying connector configs to new destinations (fivetran-docs-30). But there is no explicit documentation of a data-export/migration path for leaving Fivetran itself, no anti-lock-in statement, and no independent confirmation that exported data is fully open and portable. Missing for 10: explicit data-export/migration tooling, documented lock-in-free guarantees, independent verification of open-format portability.
